text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I take pride in building reliable software that solves real problems. With 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning, I’d be glad to help you create a Windows desktop cryptography application for educational purposes.

Your project is about building a Python executable that can encrypt or decrypt a user’s data on a Windows computer. I understand the importance of handling this carefully, both from a technical and a user-experience perspective. My focus would be on creating a clear, dependable application flow that makes the encryption and decryption process straightforward for educational use, while keeping the implementation clean and maintainable.

In my background, I’ve worked extensively with Python, scikit-learn, pandas, machine learning, and related tooling, and I’m comfortable developing practical applications that need to be dependable. I also have experience working with FastAPI, Celery, Redis, and PostgreSQL when building production systems.

One relevant project I built was a support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. I created a classifier that routed incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues, served it with FastAPI, and set up nightly retraining through a Celery worker on Redis. That work improved macro-F1 to 0.88 versus 0.62 for the old keyword rules, and reduced median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes. While that project was different in domain, it reflects the same kind of careful engineering, structured logic, and reliability that this application would require.

If selected, I’d approach this by focusing on a clean Python implementation, clear separation of encryption and decryption logic, and a desktop-friendly executable suitable for Windows. I’d also make sure the application behavior is understandable for educational use and that the user experience remains simple and direct.

I’d be happy to discuss your goals and help build this into a solid, working desktop application.
